Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged and underperforming positions to protect your capital on margin.
plays: Respect your QQQI stop at $52; it's right there. Consider trimming or exiting if it breaks to protect capital.
Re-evaluate SOXL and SPAL stops. Their deep losses and leveraged nature on margin demand tighter risk control than current default stops.
